classifiedFinding.title: setStakedId does not call _recomputeSchedule; views and ScheduleRecomputed event stream report stale values until next interaction

classification.assetImpact: None on-chain. Sister setters setDispatcherIndex and setNFTMinter call _recomputeSchedule at the end; setStakedId does not. Off-chain indexers driven by ScheduleRecomputed miss the ID-change boundary.
attackPath: 2. No ScheduleRecomputed event fires; no _recomputeSchedule runs.
3. Off-chain consumers continue to attribute schedule data to the prior stakedId until a stake / unstake / claim / pullAndRefresh fires.
classification.likelihood: n/a - state-machine asymmetry rather than an exploit.

classifiedFinding.justification: Low / state hygiene. No on-chain asset impact; breaks an implicit invariant ('schedule reflects current config once setter returns') preserved across sister setters. Recommendation: append _recomputeSchedule() to setStakedId.
